description: A projection derivation annotation (design §6.2/§6.3) carrying its base fields plus the three registered standard additions ratified by program §7.21 / plan Addendum 2026-07-28-c (blockHash, finalityTier, contractGeneration). The implemented annotation schema is unknown-field-tolerant: these MUST pass through unstripped and unrejected to the injected SubstrateChecker.
